title: Constrained Partial Derivative Holding z Constant
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: For the same system w = x^2 + y^2 + z^2 with z = x + y, find (dw/dx)_z.

steps.title: Eliminate Dependent Variable y
steps.mathExpression: z = x + y \implies y = z - x \implies w = x^2 + (z - x)^2 + z^2 = x^2 + z^2 - 2xz + x^2 + z^2 = 2x^2 - 2xz + 2z^2
steps.explanation: Express w in terms of independent coordinates x and z.
steps.why: Selecting (x, z) as independent coordinate basis.

steps.title: Differentiate with Respect to x Holding z Constant
steps.explanation: Compute partial derivative treating z as constant.
steps.why: Evaluating constrained rate with different fixed variable.
